notes.title: Terminal Insanity: RackJacker -- Devlog #4
notes.content:
THE FOLLOWING IS A REPOST DUE TO THE STREAM BEING POSTPONED:

Hi, people,

We've just confirmed the date of our next developer log! It's gonna happen on the 25th of August, 2022, on Twitch, YouTube, and here on Steam.

We'll present the latest level updates, the mission/task system, the release schedule (Early Access AND full release), and let you know what else is coming.

https://youtu.be/H9jPq_DDRy8
Stay tuned and make sure to visit us on the 25th!

Thanks

notes.title: Open testing available!
notes.content:
Hey Steam Community,

We're excited to announce that you can test RackJacker for free for a limited time!

We're approaching Early Access (Beta), and as such, we need to eliminate as many issues as possible and polish the game based on general user feedback, so anyone who would like to try it out can now do so for free.

The following is the official guide on how to join the testing program:

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2840630739]RackJacker Open Testing Official Steam Guide[/url]

Thank you and stay safe!

WonderQueenDK
Community Manager

notes.title: Streaming today!
notes.content:
Hello, Steam Community!

In less than 5 hours, we'll begin a stream of our upcoming game, [b]RackJacker[/b]!
We'll showcase the new features in the game and announce upcoming plans, as well as the Early Access release date.

If you haven't yet, join our [url=https://simtoon.tech/discord]Discord community[/url] to stay up to date ;-)

Thanks!
